verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Just as I am
You welcome me
With open arms
How can this be

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
My guilt is undone
My past is untethered
I leave it behind
And run to my Father

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
There is no disappointment in Your eyes
There is no shame there is only pride

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
I am loved
Father, I'm loved by You

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
So unreserved
Your heart for me
My fear is gone
I am set free

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
There's nothing to hide
There's nothing to measure
Cause I am Your child
And that's all that matters

verse.name: c2a
verse.lines:
There is no disappointment in Your eyes
There is no shame there is only pride

verse.name: c2b
verse.lines:
I am loved
Father, I'm loved by You

verse.name: c2c
verse.lines:
There is no distance in Your embrace
Over and over again You say

verse.name: c2d
verse.lines:
I am loved
Father, I'm loved by You

verse.name: b1a
verse.lines:
You are changing everything
You are changing everything

verse.name: b1b
verse.lines:
I believe it
I receive it
You are changing everything
